“Are we early?” Mira asked. “Only by seven minutes,” said Jo, checking the clock above the door. The room smelled of fresh paint,
but the tables were already covered with paper. A small sign read: Bring a question; leave with an idea. Mira put her notebook
beside a blue cup and wrote, “What makes a useful first attempt?” Jo drew a crooked circle. Neither expected a perfect answer
that morning. They wanted something they could try, explain, and improve together, without pretending that a promising sketch
